title: Travel Booking Facade
instructions: Implement the `BookingProcessor` facade in `booking/booking_processor.py`. Its constructor takes the five services in the same order as `BookingManager`, and `process(...)` runs availability, payment, confirmation, loyalty and accommodation updates in order, returning the right `BookingResult` on each failure. `BookingManager` is provided and only forwards to the processor.

evidence.label: BookingManager keeps none of the five services
The processor takes the services in the manager's order
Happy path runs availability, payment, notify, loyalty, details in order
Every service call receives the exact arguments
Failed payment stops before any side effect
Payment status works as a string or an Enum
BookingManager works end to end through the facade
